title: CPF Module Schema: ExpressRoute Circuit Peering module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-expressroutecircuitpeering'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

express_route_circuit_name.description: (Required) Name of the express route circuit

ipv4_enabled.description: (Optional) A boolean value indicating whether the IPv4 peering is enabled. Defaults to true

ipv6.description: (Optional) A boolean value indicating whether the IPv6 peering is enabled. Defaults to true

microsoft_peering_config_ipv4.type: object({ advertised_public_prefixes = optional(list(string)) customer_asn = optional(number) routing_registry_name = optional(string) advertised_communities = optional(list(string)) })
microsoft_peering_config_ipv4.description: object({ (Optional) advertised_public_prefixes = "(Required) A list of Advertised Public Prefixes" customer_asn = "(optional) The CustomerASN of the peering. Defaults to 0 routing_registry_name = "(optional) The Routing Registry against which the AS number and prefixes are registered. For example: ARIN, RIPE, AFRINIC etc. Defaults to NONE" advertised_communities = "(optional) The communities of Bgp Peering specified for microsoft peering." })

microsoft_peering_config_ipv6.type: object({ advertised_public_prefixes = optional(list(string)) customer_asn = optional(number) routing_registry_name = optional(string) advertised_communities = optional(list(string)) })
microsoft_peering_config_ipv6.description: object({(optional) advertised_public_prefixes = "(Required) A list of Advertised Public Prefixes" customer_asn = "(optional) The CustomerASN of the peering. Defaults to 0 routing_registry_name = "(optional) The Routing Registry against which the AS number and prefixes are registered. For example: ARIN, RIPE, AFRINIC etc. Defaults to NONE" advertised_communities = "(optional) The communities of Bgp Peering specified for microsoft peering." })

peer_asn.description: (Required) The Either a 16-bit or a 32-bit ASN. Can either be public or private.

peering_type.description: (Required) The type of the ExpressRoute Circuit Peering. Acceptable values include AzurePrivatePeering and MicrosoftPeering.

primary_peer_address_prefix_ipv4.description: (Required) A /30 subnet for the primary link. Required when config for IPv4.

primary_peer_address_prefix_ipv6.description: (Required) A /30 subnet for the primary link. Required when config for IPv6.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

secondary_peer_address_prefix_ipv4.description: (Required) A /30 subnet for the secondary link. Required when config for IPv4.

secondary_peer_address_prefix_ipv6.description: (Required) A /30 subnet for the secondary link. Required when config for IPv6.

shared_key.description: (Optional) The shared key. Can be a maximum of 25 characters.

vlan_id.description: (Required) A valid VLAN ID to establish this peering on.

circuit_peering_id.description: The ID of the ExpressRoute Circuit Peering.

private_peering_primary_azure_port.description: The Primary Port used by Azure for this Peering.

private_peering_secondary_azure_port.description: The secondary Port used by Azure for this Peering.

resource.description: The Express Route Circuit Peering Resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Expressroutecircuitpeering' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
